Hello Professor Alvarez — this is Hana's assistant. Hana would like to set up her 30-minute 1:1 with you next week. Looking at her calendar, these slots are free and inside her working hours (Mon–Fri, 09:00–17:00):

- Monday 10:00–10:30
- Monday 14:00–14:30
- Wednesday 13:00–13:30
- Wednesday 15:00–15:30
- Thursday 10:00–10:30

Does any of those work for you? If you have a preferred time outside this list, tell me and I'll check it against her schedule.

Hi Professor Alvarez — this is sarah-agent, Sarah's assistant. Sarah would like to book her 30-minute 1:1 with you next week (Mon Nov 23 – Fri Nov 27).

Her free half-hour slots within her 09:00–17:00 working hours are:
- Mon Nov 23, 10:00–10:30
- Mon Nov 23, 14:00–14:30
- Tue Nov 24, 11:00–11:30
- Tue Nov 24, 15:00–15:30
- Fri Nov 27, 11:00–11:30

Does any of those work for you, or would you suggest another time?

Hello Professor Alvarez — I'm diego-agent, Diego's assistant. Diego would like to book his 30-minute 1:1 with you next week (Mon Nov 23 – Fri Nov 27).

His free 30-minute windows inside working hours (09:00–17:00) that week are:
- Mon 10:00-10:30
- Mon 14:00-14:30
- Wed 10:00-10:30
- Wed 13:00-13:30
- Wed 15:00-15:30

Which of these suits you? I'll confirm and put it in his calendar.

Hi Professor Alvarez — this is Priya. I need to book our 30-minute 1:1 for next week and would like to find a time that suits you.

Within my working hours (Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00) I have these 30-minute free slots next week:
- Monday Nov 23: 10:00–10:30 or 14:00–14:30
- Tuesday Nov 24: 15:00–15:30
- Wednesday Nov 25: 10:00–10:30 or 13:00–13:30

Would any of these work for you? If none does, let me know a time that does and I'll see what I can move.
Hello — Monday 10:00–10:30 works. I've booked Hana's 30-minute 1:1 with Professor Alvarez for **Monday, 24 November, 10:00–10:30**. It's on his calendar; no conflicts on his side.

Thank you! One wrinkle on the date: Monday next week is the **23rd** of November — the 24th is a Tuesday. Hana is free Monday 23 November 10:00–10:30, so if you meant that, we're all set and I'll put it on her calendar. Tuesday the 24th at 10:00 won't work for her: she has the CSE455 quiz section 10:10–11:00. Could you confirm it's Monday 23 November, 10:00–10:30?
Hi Sarah's assistant — Tuesday 11:00–11:30 works. Booked: **Sarah's 1:1 with Professor Alvarez, Tue 24 Nov, 11:00–11:30**. It's on his calendar.
Hi Diego's assistant — Wednesday 10:00–10:30 works. Booked: **Diego's 1:1 with Professor Alvarez, Wed 25 Nov, 10:00–10:30**. It's on his calendar.
Hi Priya — Wednesday 13:00–13:30 works. Booked: **Priya's 1:1 with Professor Alvarez, Wed 25 Nov, 13:00–13:30**. It's on his calendar.
You're right — my date was off. Confirmed: **Hana's 1:1 with Professor Alvarez, Monday 23 November, 10:00–10:30** (not the 24th). That's what's on his calendar. Sorry for the confusion.
Perfect, thank you — Sarah's 1:1 is booked for Tue 24 Nov, 11:00–11:30, and it's on her calendar now. Have a good week.
Confirmed on my side: Hana's 1:1 with Professor Alvarez, **Monday 23 November, 10:00–10:30**, is on her calendar. Thanks for sorting out the date so quickly.
Perfect — Wednesday 13:00–13:30 it is. I've put it in my calendar too. See you then, and thanks!
Thank you — confirmed and logged: Diego's 1:1 with you, **Wednesday 25 November, 10:00–10:30**. It's in his calendar now.

Hello Professor Alvarez — this is john-agent, John's assistant. John asked me to book his 30-minute 1:1 with you for next week.

Looking at his calendar for next week (Mon Nov 23 – Fri Nov 27), our best windows inside 09:00–17:00 are:

- **Tuesday 15:00–15:30** (right before the 15:30–17:00 Advisor 1:1 block he already has down)
- Monday 14:00–14:30
- Wednesday 10:00–10:30

Would **Tuesday 15:00–15:30** work for you? If another time suits you better, just tell me when and I'll fit it in. Once you confirm I'll put it in his calendar and come back to you with the confirmed slot.

Hi John's assistant — **Tuesday 24 November, 15:00–15:30** works. Booked: **John's 1:1 with Professor Alvarez, Tue 24 Nov, 15:00–15:30** (it ends right before his 15:30–17:00 block). It's on his calendar — please confirm on John's side.
Confirmed on John's side: **John's 1:1 with Professor Alvarez — Tuesday 24 November, 15:00–15:30**, in his calendar and logged. Thank you, Professor.
